summary: Iteration 2 backend testing complete. All 20 tests PASSED covering: quote config (10 materials, 3 qualities, 4 nozzles, max_colors=8), quote engine correctness (hi>regular pricing, 0.25>0.4 nozzle pricing, color scaling, bulk discounts 5%/10%, 404 unknown product, weight-only quote), product enrichment (9 products all with preview_shape/print_weight_grams/recommended_colors), i18n (12 languages returned), GPT-5.2 auto-translation actually working (Spanish detected + English detected, >=8 of 12 translations present in both cases), chat history + since filter + 400 on empty text + 403 for non-owner /chat/rooms, plus regressions (products, external search, wishlist toggle, order creation).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~836 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, products, quote, chat, designs) for maintainability.
compute_quote weight formula `weight * (0.55 + 0.45*(infill/20))` grows large for high infill (100% -> 2.8x); intended but worth confirming.
chat_send upsert uses an inline await inside a $set dict which runs on every message — minor perf; consider fetching customer_name once at room creation.
_is_owner depends on ADMIN_EMAILS env var; when unset all users are non-owner (verified). Consider documenting this default.
Translation fallback silently returns empty translations dict on LLM failure — acceptable but consider surfacing a warning field in response.
